summary: First delivery. Ran 23 pytest cases covering auth, role isolation, consumer flows, full QR+Transaction lifecycle, merchant dashboard/stories/est-update, admin overview/settings/approve/consumer-update, plus Playwright E2E on consumer, merchant and admin. All backend tests pass. Frontend consumer/merchant/admin flows all navigate correctly and render expected content.

issues: Uses browser native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar component; consider replacing <input type='date'> with the shadcn Calendar/Popover for consistency and localization
When only seeded (already approved) establishments exist, no visible 'Approve' button surfaces — verify UX for pending list is discoverable (filter tab labelled Pendentes/Aprovados)

action_items: (Minor design) Replace native date input in Raffles create dialog with shadcn Calendar picker
(Optional) Verify Explore renders all 6 approved establishments in mobile view — automation found the cards but selector count was inconclusive (likely fine)
critical_code_review_comments: Cookies set with SameSite=None + Secure — good for cross-site preview URLs; ensure HTTPS in prod.
get_current_user updates last_activity on every request (extra write per API call) — consider throttling to reduce Mongo write load at scale.
routes_admin.merchants: uses est.get('fantasy_name') without None-guard inside q filter (est may be None) — potential AttributeError if merchant lacks establishment AND q is provided. Low priority.
Transaction 'awaiting_confirmation' has token_expires_at=10min — merchant UI must confirm within that window; consumer polling handles it fine.
hash_password uses bcrypt correctly, returns $2b$ hash. Login lockout after 5 fails/15min implemented.
strip_id removes _id AND password_hash — good. All routes go through it consistently.
seed.py updates admin only when missing (does NOT rotate password if env changes) — flagged only if admin password rotation is expected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (consumer, merchant, admin flows all reachable and rendering)

seed_data_creation: Tests register a few TEST_ consumer/merchant accounts via /api/auth/register (email lowercased server-side to 'test_...'). One TEST_ consumer is toggled to active subscription by admin test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Email addresses are lowercased on register/login. Auth accepts Bearer token equal to access_token cookie value. Merchant discount changes are queued as pending_changes and NOT applied immediately (by design). Camera QR scan cannot be tested headless — manual code fallback (data-testid=scan-manual-input) works.
